notes.format: [u0, v0, u1, v1] pixel edges, u1/v1 exclusive, drawn once from the reference, never moved
notes.head: both ear tips, skull, cheeks, muzzle, chin, top of neck (to v=700)
notes.tail: whole tail from the fluffy tip to the rump junction (u<500)
notes.legs: everything below the belly line v=1000 incl. all four legs, paws and the background between and around them down past the paw contacts
notes.torso: back line to belly line between rump and chest; overlaps head window in u 928-1232, v 598-700 (neck/chest top) and touches legs at v=1000
